==History==
She is Wise one to [[Clan chief]] [[Mandelain]] at the [[Jahad Hold]] of the Broken Cliff sept. 

She is only mentioned in [[The Wheel of Time Companion]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Mandelain}}
